name: Nez Perce dried salmon
description: Nez Perce people supplied dried salmon as food during the 1805 encounter at Weippe.

impact.note: One recorded event witnessing a long-standing regional staple of dried fish, with nothing later known to rest on this record.

date.label: September 1805
date.basis: Source date for the documented context; BP conversion uses 1950 as reference where applicable.

events.statement: Nez Perce people supplied dried salmon as food during the 1805 encounter at Weippe.

evidence.supports: In late September 1805, Nez Perce supplied the expedition with dried salmon and camas bread. The source documents food supplied, not a particular drying procedure or age of the practice.

events.caveats: The account documents access to dried salmon; it does not specify the drying method, scale or origins. This witness does not by itself identify who dried the fish or where it was dried.
